diffs.diff: distance_cm: datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The model is the HLK-LD2420 read through its OT2 GPIO only (interface digital-out, sim kind digital-sensor). Per the Hi-Link HLK-LD2420 manual, Table 3-2: J2 pin 5 OT2 is an 'IO for reporting detection status: high for occupied, low for unoccupied', 0-3.3 V; it carries no distance value, so the model has no distance quantity to convert. The manual gives no 'counts' scale for distance at all: it only says the radar 'reports the straight-line distance of the target' over UART (section 8), with distance gates of '70 cm' resolution (Table 4-2) and range accuracy of 0.35 m. The second reading's distance_cm scale of 1 per count is not stated in this source and applies to no quantity the model outputs.
